    Why sugar, not wax

    Gentler going on. Better growing back.

    The paste is warmed, not heated; it grips hair, not skin, and lifts with the grain. It even rinses off with water, which is why it can go places wax can't. In Kirstan's words, here's what changes.

    Thinner & finer hair

    Sugared hair grows back ultra soft — say goodbye to stubble. Roots get shallower and sparser over time; sugaring is semi-permanent.

    Get glowing

    The paste exfoliates as it lifts, so skin comes out radiant. Wonderful for brightening tattoos or just clearing dry skin cells.

    No ingrown hair

    Pulled with the grain, not against it — no ingrowns, no razor burn, no bumps, no cuts.

    Less irritation

    Quick recovery. Sugar is gentler than wax, so there's less redness and less downtime.

    Skin

    Facials that start with a look, not a menu.

    Kirstan is a holistic skin care expert. Every facial is handcrafted after she assesses what your skin actually needs — then she curates the blend: healing herbs, superfoods and superfruits, botanicals, full-spectrum CBD, ancient remedies, and her signature gua sha massage with herbal poultice and cupping.

    The aim is to treat skin from deep within — restored, tighter, a natural lift — rather than a one-size peel.

    On the shelf: Farm House Fresh Little Seed Farm deodorant creams Sweet & True sugaring botanicals

    Who

    The person behind the paste.

    Öka is a one-person studio. Kirstan books you, Kirstan sugars you, and Kirstan remembers how your skin reacted last time. No front desk, no rotating staff — which is exactly why the regulars are regulars.

    24-hour reschedule

    Change or cancel a day ahead. Inside 24 hours, up to a $25 fee goes to the card on file.
